name: dokploy
description_en: Open Source Alternative to Vercel, Netlify and Heroku.
readme_excerpt: Join us on Discord for help, feedback, and discussions! Dokploy is a free, self-hostable Platform as a Service (PaaS) that simplifies the deployment and management of applications and databases. ✨ Features Dokploy includes multiple features to make your life easier. - Applications: Deploy any type of application (Node.js, PHP, Python, Go, Ruby, etc.). - Databases: Create and manage databases with support for MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, MariaDB, libsql, and Redis. - Backups: Automate backups for…
